action.description: Action field of the M&C log line (e.g. OUT, IN)

code.description: M&C message code from the log line (e.g. DC for Data Circulation)

domain.description: M&C domain of the log line (e.g. Data Circulation)

filename.description: Name of the circulated file referenced by the log line

filesize.description: Size in bytes of the circulated file

hostname.description: Host name of the S3P station server that emitted the log line

log_date.description: Date the log line was emitted, used as the monthly partition field

pid.description: Process identifier of the circulation agent from the log line

queueid.description: Identifier of the circulation queue entry

reportName.description: Identifier of the source report or log file the record was extracted from

status.description: Status reported for the circulation of the file

tourl.description: Destination URL the file was circulated to
